checks.claim: A reminder that fell due while the app was closed notifies exactly once when the app next starts.
checks.failsWhen: None arrives. Two arrive. Or one arrives on every later start.
checks.holdsWhen: One notification arrives within a few seconds of the start, and none on the next two starts.
checks.evidence: A test that stops the process, moves the clock past the time, starts a fresh process, and counts the notifications across three starts.
checks.limits: Says nothing about a phone that stops background work.

checks.claim: The change adds no store call whose failure is caught and dropped.
checks.failsWhen: A new `catch` around a store call logs and continues.
checks.evidence: The diff, read at every new or changed store call.
